recognize_zh: 三顆中型淋巴球，核圓且邊緣平滑、染色質較疏鬆、核仁不明顯，細胞質豐富淡灰藍色，周邊呈毛絨絨的細絲狀突起（hairy projections）環繞整個細胞，這就是毛細胞白血病的毛細胞。
features: Medium-sized mononuclear cells, about 1.5–2 times a red cell diameter
Abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm with circumferential fine, fuzzy hair-like projections
Round nuclei with smooth contours, some slightly oval
Moderately open, finely stippled chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Background red cells include occasional crenated echinocytes (likely artifact); no granulocytes or monocytes in field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered medium-sized lymphoid cells with round, smooth-contoured nuclei, moderately open chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cells have abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections and ill-defined borders. Background red cells show occasional crenation, likely artifactual, and no monocytes are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant / splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: HCL-variant cells have prominent central nucleoli, higher counts without monocytopenia, and are CD25-negative and BRAF wild-type.
SMZL villous lymphocytes are smaller with more condensed chromatin and short polar projections rather than circumferential hairs, and lack CD103/CD25 co-expression.
Monocytes have folded nuclei, lacy chromatin and grey vacuolated cytoplasm without fine hair-like projections.
LGLs have round nuclei with condensed chromatin and azurophilic cytoplasmic granules rather than agranular cytoplasm with fuzzy borders.
